_register: Buttons, menu entries and step lists use the bare imperative stem as Turkish software does (Ödünç ver, Kaydet, Barkodu okut, İptal); sentences addressed to the reader are polite and formal (« siz », -in/-ın/-un/-ün endings: « Lütfen barkodu okutun »), or impersonal passive/noun forms for status and error messages (« Kayıt silindi »); never the informal « sen » in sentences; no jokes, no exclamation marks.
_quotes: Double curly quotes “text” (U+201C, U+201D) with no spaces inside, nested quotes ‘ ’; no space before : ; ? ! % ; the arrow → stays. Suffixes attach to a quoted text or a placeholder only after an apostrophe, which is hard to do correctly, so reword the sentence so that no case suffix follows a {{placeholder}} (« Ödünç verilen: {{title}} », not « {{title}}'e »). Use sentence case (only the first word and proper names capitalised); uppercase text must follow Turkish rules (i → İ, ı → I), so avoid hard-coded uppercase and let CSS or a Turkish-locale call do it.
_plural: Turkish has two plural forms in the software sense (one, other), but a noun after a number stays singular (« 3 öğrenci », « 1 öğrenci »), so both forms usually hold the same word; the plural suffix -lar/-ler is used only without a number (« Öğrenciler »).

copy.note: One physical copy with its own barcode; the standard word in Turkish library terminology (TKD, TDK). Not « kopya » (a photocopy or imitation) and not « adet »; « demirbaş » is the inventory number and is not used.

record.note: Bibliographic record (« bibliyografik kayıt »), the catalogue entry of a title; Koha's Turkish interface says « kayıt » too. Where « registration » is meant elsewhere, use « kaydetme » or « üyelik » to avoid the clash.

patron.note: Library member; usual in Turkish school and public libraries and in Koha's Turkish interface. « Okuyucu » is also used but « üye » matches « üye kartı ». Plural « üyeler » in the menu.

card.note: Short form « kart » where the context is clear.

loan.note: The action and the area (« Ödünç İşlemleri » in the menu); a loan as an item is « ödünç » (« ödünç kitaplar »). Button: « Ödünç ver ».

return.note: The action: « İade » on the menu, « iade al » or « iadeyi kaydet » for the verb.

renew.note: Extending the due date; button « Süreyi uzat ». Turkish libraries say « süre uzatma »; « yenileme » is not used.

due date.note: Short form of « son iade tarihi ».

overdue.note: Adjective (« gecikmiş kitaplar »); the noun « gecikme » for the delay itself.

reminder.note: The printed slip asking for the return: « hatırlatma notu »; « uyarı » is avoided as too harsh for students.

call number.note: The shelf mark on the spine, as in Turkish libraries (« yer numarası »); « raf numarası » and « çağrı numarası » are not used.

spine band.note: The coloured band with pictogram and yer numarası on the spine; « sırt etiketi » is understood but « etiket » is kept for the barcode label.

barcode.note: One word, as in all Turkish software (not « çubuk kod »).

class.note: The school class (« 3 B sınıfı »); the same word as the school year level, which is avoided in the interface.

group.note: Used for a group of teachers.

reading level.note: « Düzey » rather than « seviye » (the TDK-preferred word).

genre.note: « Edebi tür » in full where needed; « kitap türü » for the kind of book.

classification.note: The sorting scheme (« Dewey Onlu Sınıflandırması » for non-fiction); not to be confused with « sınıf » (class), which is why the word is always « sınıflandırma ».

stocktaking.note: Checking the shelves against the catalogue; « kütüphane sayımı » in full. « Envanter » means the register of acquisitions (demirbaş defteri) in Turkish libraries, so it is not used here.

wish list.note: Books a patron would like the library to have; « öneri listesi » is also used but « istek » is plainer.

census.note: Registering the üyeler with their photo; « sayım » is taken by the stocktaking and « kayıt » by the record, so the activity is named for what is done. Menu entry « Fotoğraf çekimi ».

class upgrade.note: Moving every class up a year at the end of the school year (« 3 B » becomes « 4 B »).

anonymise.note: Noun « anonimleştirme »; irreversible erasure of the personal data.

backup.note: The copy itself (« yedek dosyası »); the action is « yedekleme », button « Yedekle ».

restore.note: Verb « geri yüklemek », button « Geri yükle ».

colour set.note: The palette of the interface; written « renk » (not « renk takımı »).

scanner.note: The USB barcode reader that types like a keyboard; the verb for scanning is « okutmak » (« barkodu okutun »).

demo data.note: The invented school the program fills itself with; « demo verileri » is also heard but « örnek » is plainer.

school year.note: The official term of the Ministry of National Education; « okul yılı » is colloquial.

configuration.note: Settings pages: « Ayarlar » is acceptable as the short menu label where space is tight, but « yapılandırma » is used for the area.

return desk / circulation desk.note: The desk where loans and returns are handled (« ödünç ve iade masası » in full); the area as a whole is « Ödünç İşlemleri ».
